parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The business space key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: The member and synonyms (similar questions) of a standard noun.

parameters.name: RemoveType
parameters.description:
The type of content to remove. Valid values:
- memberName: a member of a proper noun
- synonyms: similar questions of a proper noun.
